name: manageJingleScript
description: Write and render jingles (short music with sound effects) plus a timing map an animation can sync to. Start with action getGuide, then getSchema; write a score; checkScore and fix every error; then renderScore. renderScore shows a player with the waveform, cues and beats.

action.description: What to do. The loop: getGuide (how to write a jingle) → getSchema (the exact format) → write a score → checkScore → fix every error → renderScore. listInstruments / getInstrument show the sounds.

part.description: getSchema: one part only ("score" is the whole format, "timing" the timing map's).

instrument.description: getInstrument: the instrument or sound effect's name.

fileName.description: renderScore: file stem for the outputs (default "jingle").

format.description: renderScore: "wav" (default), "mp3" or "ogg" (MP3 and OGG need ffmpeg).
